description: Agent Insurance: submit one policy’s exclusions with the insured activity: the activity with its description and its material parts, such as subcontracted work or drone use; each exclusion with its id, the exclusion as written, the activities, parts or causes it names, the broader coverage it carves out of for a carve-out inside a coverage grant, and whether it was disclosed to the buyer before purchase as recorded; and each endorsement that restores excluded coverage, with its id, the exclusion it restores, the parts it restores (every part when left out) and its text. The signed report gives the activity, every exclusion with the activity and parts it meets, the endorsements restoring it, the parts restored and left unrestored, whether it was disclosed and any catch-all wording such as arising out of or directly or indirectly, every endorsement with whether it points at an exclusion the policy holds, and the disclosure tally, and counts them, and names a blocking exclusion: an exclusion that names the activity itself, an exclusion that names a material part of it, and a carve-out that takes the activity back out of broader coverage, each with no endorsement restoring it; then an exclusion not disclosed to the buyer, catch-all wording that can reach the activity without naming it and an endorsement pointing at no exclusion, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No activity, no material parts, no exclusions, exclusions with no names or text, or exclusions with no disclosure record leaves the exclusions unverified. This reads one policy’s exclusions against the insured activity: a counterparty’s policy excerpt read as diligence evidence is wever_insurance-evidence-check, the exclusions a warranty claim meets are wever_warranty-check and the exclusions in guarantee terms against the promise are wever_guarantee-evidence-check. Verdict insurance_exclusions_block, insurance_exclusions_partial, insurance_exclusions_unverified or insurance_exclusions_clear. POST /api/insurance-exclusions-check. Reads the insurance records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, claim filing, coverage binding or external write. Agent Insurance reads an insurance policy after the fact, from the subject’s own records: the coverage against the insured activity, the exclusions against the activity and its parts, the limits against the stated exposure, the deductible against what the buyer was told, the claims deadlines against an incident, a certificate against the policy it was issued from, incident notice under the policy and a renewal against the expiring policy. Beside it, wever_insurance-evidence-check reads a counterparty’s insurance certificate or policy excerpt as diligence evidence and reports what that material establishes against required coverages, limits and a work window, while an insurance check reads the subject’s own policy against a stated need, an incident or a certificate issued from it; wever_warranty-check reads a warranty claim against warranty terms, while an insurance check reads an insurance policy; and wever_risk-downside-check reads a planned action’s downside before it is taken, while an insurance check reads the policy behind it after the fact. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-insurance-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-insurance/.
